explaination_text: AWS WAF (Web Application Firewall) has built-in rules to detect and block common web exploits like SQL injection before they reach the backend.

question_text: Weekly batch jobs on EC2. Baseline CPU 60%. Provision capacity 30 mins before jobs run. Automated way with LEAST overhead? Which solution?
answer_text: Create a predictive scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Configure the policy to scale based on forecast. Set the target value to 60%. Set instances to pre-launch 30 minutes before.
explaination_text: Predictive scaling uses machine learning to forecast traffic and scales out ahead of time, ensuring capacity is ready before the workload arrives.

question_text: DR architecture for MySQL on EC2 in private subnet. Multiple Regions required. LEAST operational overhead?
answer_text: Migrate the MySQL database to an Amazon Aurora global database. Host the primary DB cluster in the primary Region. Host the secondary DB cluster in the DR Region.
explaination_text: Aurora Global Database handles cross-region replication automatically, providing much lower overhead than managing MySQL replication on EC2 across regions.

question_text: Java application uses SQS but cannot parse messages > 256 KB. Solution for messages up to 50 MB with FEWEST code changes?
answer_text: Use the Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java to host messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon S3.
explaination_text: The SQS Extended Client automatically offloads large message payloads to S3 and sends a reference via SQS, requiring very minimal developer code changes.

question_text: Restrict web app content with authorization. Serverless architecture, < 100 users. Serve globally. Lowest login latency. MOST cost-effective?
answer_text: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use Lambda@Edge for authorization. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the web application globally.
explaination_text: Cognito handles users serverlessly. Lambda@Edge processes authorization at global edge locations, providing the lowest possible latency for users.

question_text: Aging NAS (SMB/NFS). Migrate data to S3, use Lifecycle policies, maintain same look and feel for clients. Which type of storage gateway?
answer_text: Amazon S3 File Gateway
explaination_text: S3 File Gateway provides a local SMB/NFS interface that maps to S3 buckets, allowing users to continue using standard file shares while data resides in the cloud.

question_text: Maximize cost savings for EC2 over 3 years. Need ability to change instance family and sizes in 6 months. MOST cost-effectively?
answer_text: Compute Savings Plan
explaination_text: Compute Savings Plans provide the flexibility to change instance families, sizes, regions, and even switch to Fargate or Lambda while still receiving the discount.

question_text: Data in DynamoDB constant and predictable. Stay at or below forecasted budget. Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
answer_text: Use provisioned mode. Specify the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs).
explaination_text: Provisioned mode is cheaper than On-Demand mode for predictable workloads where capacity requirements are constant.

question_text: Securely share an Aurora backup (encrypted with KMS) with an acquiring company's AWS account in the same Region. What should be done?
answer_text: Create a database snapshot. Add the acquiring company’s AWS account to the KMS key policy. Share the snapshot with the acquiring company’s AWS account.
explaination_text: To share an encrypted snapshot, you must share the snapshot itself and grant the target account permissions to use the KMS key that encrypted it.

question_text: RDS SQL Server Single-AZ. Need high availability and automatic recovery. Improve reporting performance. Combination of steps? (Choose two.)
answer_text: A. Modify the DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment. C. Create a read replica and point all reporting requests to it.
explaination_text: Multi-AZ provides high availability and automatic failover. Read replicas offload reporting queries from the primary instance to improve performance.

question_text: Transition to event-driven architecture. Distributed serverless concepts. Minimize operational overhead. Which solution?
answer_text: Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Use Step Functions to create a state machine to invoke AWS Lambda functions.
explaination_text: Step Functions is a serverless orchestrator that coordinates distributed Lambda functions into a reliable workflow with minimal management overhead.

question_text: Multi-player UDP game in 8 Regions. Minimize latency and packet loss for global users. Which solution?
answer_text: Set up AWS Global Accelerator with UDP listeners and endpoint groups in each Region.
explaination_text: Global Accelerator uses the AWS global private network to route traffic to the nearest regional endpoint, significantly improving latency and reliability for UDP traffic.

question_text: Move self-managed MySQL on EC2 to fully managed, HA, and fault-tolerant solution. double IOPS capacity (1,000 peak). MOST cost-effectively?
answer_text: Use a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with a General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volume.
explaination_text: RDS Multi-AZ handles failover and management. General Purpose SSD (gp2) volumes easily support the required 1,000 IOPS and are more cost-effective than Provisioned IOPS.

question_text: Serverless app (API Gateway + Lambda + RDS PostgreSQL) has connection timeouts during peak traffic. Reduce failures with least code change. What should be done?
answer_text: Enable RDS Proxy on the RDS DB instance.
explaination_text: RDS Proxy pools connections, preventing the exhaustion of DB connections that occurs when many Lambda instances spin up simultaneously.

question_text: CPU intensive batch job runs every hour for 15 mins. LEAST operational overhead? Which solution?
answer_text: Use AWS Batch on Amazon EC2.
explaination_text: AWS Batch is a fully managed service that provisions compute resources specifically for batch jobs, managing the lifecycle and scaling automatically.

question_text: 75% data rarely accessed after 30 days. Remain immediately accessible with high HA/resiliency. Minimize costs. Which storage solution?
answer_text: Move the data objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
explaination_text: S3 Standard-IA offers lower storage prices than S3 Standard while providing millisecond retrieval for infrequently accessed data across multiple AZs.

question_text: Scoreboard on EC2 Windows. Highly available storage for static files and dynamic code. Combination of steps? (Choose two.)
answer_text: A. Store static files on Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront to cache. D. Store server-side code on Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.
explaination_text: S3 and CloudFront are the standard for static hosting. FSx for Windows provides the shared SMB file system needed for dynamic code across multiple Windows EC2 instances.

question_text: Resize billion images in S3 dynamically and serve formats to clients. LEAST operational overhead?
answer_text: Use a Lambda@Edge function with an external image management library. Associate with CloudFront behaviors.
explaination_text: Lambda@Edge allows for serverless image processing at the edge locations, fulfilling requests dynamically without maintaining a server fleet.

question_text: PHI in S3 encrypted in transit and at rest. Compliance team must administer the key. Which solution?
answer_text: Use aws:SecureTransport on S3 bucket policies. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Assign compliance team to manage KMS keys.
explaination_text: aws:SecureTransport enforces HTTPS. SSE-KMS with Customer Managed Keys allows the compliance team full control over key management and auditing.

question_text: REST APIs in same VPC communicate over internet instead of VPC. FEWEST changes to code? Which solution?
answer_text: Use an interface endpoint.
explaination_text: Interface VPC Endpoints (PrivateLink) allow VPC resources to reach API Gateway privately within the AWS network, requiring only a change in the DNS endpoint.

question_text: Multiplayer game needs sub-millisecond latency and one-time historical queries. LEAST operational overhead? Which solution?
answer_text: Use Amazon DynamoDB with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX). Export data to S3. Run one-time queries on S3 by using Amazon Athena.
explaination_text: DAX provides the microsecond latency for the game. S3 + Athena is the most operationally efficient way to perform SQL queries on archived data.

question_text: Ensure messages for a particular payment ID are received in the same order they were sent. Which actions? (Choose two.)
answer_text: B. Write messages to Kinesis with payment ID as partition key. E. Write messages to SQS FIFO queue with payment ID as message group.
explaination_text: Kinesis partition keys and SQS FIFO message groups both guarantee that all messages for a specific ID are sent to the same shard/stream and processed in order.

question_text: Send unique events to separate services concurrently. Guarantee the order of events. Which solution?
answer_text: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topics
explaination_text: SNS FIFO allows for high-throughput ordering and exactly-once delivery to multiple SQS FIFO subscribers concurrently.

question_text: Gather patient symptoms via SQS and SNS. Encrypted at rest/transit. Authorized access only. Combination of steps? (Choose two.)
answer_text: B. SNS SSE via KMS + key policy. D. SQS SSE via KMS + key policy + TLS condition.
explaination_text: KMS handles at-rest encryption for both. IAM policies restrict access, and the SQS policy condition enforces encryption in transit (TLS).

question_text: Accidental deletion in RDS. Restore to 5 mins before change within last 30 days. Which feature to include in design?
answer_text: Automated backups
explaination_text: RDS Automated Backups enable Point-in-Time Recovery (PITR) to any second within the retention period (up to 35 days).

question_text: Improve performance/availability for global on-premises UDP application. Hosted on redundant on-prem servers. What should be done?
answer_text: Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in Regions. Use AWS Global Accelerator and register NLBs as endpoints.
explaination_text: Global Accelerator uses Anycast IPs to route global traffic over the AWS backbone to regional NLBs, which then forward to the on-prem servers.

question_text: Complexity requirements and mandatory rotation periods for IAM user passwords. What should be done?
answer_text: Set an overall password policy for the entire AWS account.
explaination_text: The IAM Password Policy allows the account owner to enforce rules like minimum length, character types, and mandatory expiration/rotation for all users.

question_text: Scheduled 1-hour tasks written by different teams (no common language) on one instance. Performance/scalability concerns. LEAST overhead?
answer_text: Use AWS Batch to run the tasks as jobs. Schedule the jobs by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events).
explaination_text: AWS Batch can run any containerized task regardless of language and scales the underlying compute resources automatically for the duration of the job.

question_text: EC2 instances in private subnets need to communicate with a license server over the internet. Managed solution, minimal maintenance. Which solution?
answer_text: Provision a NAT gateway in a public subnet. Modify private subnet route table with a default route to the NAT gateway.
explaination_text: NAT Gateway is a fully managed service that allows private instances to reach the internet for licensing/updates while remaining private.

question_text: EKS digital media app. Managed node group backed by EBS. Encrypt data at rest using customer KMS. LEAST overhead? (Choose two.)
answer_text: C. Enable EBS encryption by default in the Region. Select customer KMS key. D. Create EKS cluster with IAM role granted permission to the KMS key.
explaination_text: Default EBS encryption ensures all volumes used by EKS are encrypted. The EKS role needs explicit permission to use that KMS key for volume operations.

question_text: Migrate Oracle DB GIS images (high resolution) identified by geo code. updates occur frequently during disasters. HA + scalable. MOST cost-effectively?
answer_text: Store images in Amazon S3. Store geo codes and image S3 URLs in a database table. Use Oracle on RDS Multi-AZ.
explaination_text: Storing large blobs in a relational database is expensive and slow. S3 is optimized for large files, and RDS Oracle handles the structured metadata efficiently.

question_text: Trillions of IoT objects. retrain ML with last 30 days data. 4x yearly analysis with last 12 months. Archive after 1 year. MOST cost-effective storage?
answer_text: S3 Standard. S3 Lifecycle to transition to S3 Standard-IA after 30 days, then to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
explaination_text: S3 Standard for the initial hot data, IA for the quarterly analysis data (up to 1 year), and Deep Archive for the cheapest long-term retention.

question_text: 3 VPCs in us-east-1 communicate with each other and send 100s GB daily to latency-sensitive on-prem app. Maximize cost-effectiveness. Which solution?
answer_text: Set up one AWS Direct Connect connection. Create a transit gateway, attach each VPC. Establish connectivity between DX and Transit Gateway.
explaination_text: Transit Gateway acts as a central hub for VPCs and on-prem via a single Direct Connect gateway, reducing the number of virtual circuits and complexity.

question_text: Order-processing application needs manual approvals. Orchestrate Lambda, EC2, containers, and on-premises. LEAST operational overhead?
answer_text: Use AWS Step Functions to build the application.
explaination_text: Step Functions is designed for complex workflows and orchestration. It natively supports manual approval steps ('wait for callback') and integrates with various compute platforms.

question_text: RDS MySQL for serverless apps. High demand leads to connection rejection errors. Resolve with LEAST operational overhead?
answer_text: Create a proxy in RDS Proxy. Configure the users’ applications to use the DB instance through RDS Proxy.
explaination_text: RDS Proxy manages connection pooling, allowing thousands of serverless requests to share a small number of database connections, preventing rejections.

question_text: Ensure EC2 instances in Auto Scaling groups send auditing system reports as soon as they are launched and terminated. MOST efficient solution?
answer_text: Use EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks to run a custom script when instances are launched and terminated.
explaination_text: Lifecycle hooks pause the transition of an instance state, allowing custom actions (like audit reporting) to complete before the instance is fully live or gone.

question_text: Real-time multiplayer UDP game. adapt to spikes. Store scores and non-relational data without intervention. Which solution?
answer_text: Use a Network Load Balancer for traffic distribution and Amazon DynamoDB on-demand for data storage.
explaination_text: NLB is optimized for UDP and low latency. DynamoDB on-demand scales read/write capacity automatically to match game traffic spikes.

question_text: Frontend API Gateway + Lambda + RDS. Lambda loads many libraries. Latency must be as low as possible with fewest changes to operations. Which solution?
answer_text: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function.
explaination_text: Provisioned concurrency keeps Lambda functions initialized (warm), eliminating 'cold start' latencies caused by large library loading.

question_text: Automatically start and stop EC2 and RDS instances outside business hours. Minimize maintenance/cost. Which solution?
answer_text: Create an AWS Lambda function that will start and stop the instances. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke it on a schedule.
explaination_text: This is a lightweight serverless automation solution. EventBridge provides the cron-like scheduling, and Lambda executes the API calls.

question_text: Aurora PostgreSQL reporting takes hours. Metadata document search. Reporting must not prevent modifications. LEAST amount of change to code?
answer_text: Set up a new Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster that includes an Aurora Replica. Issue queries to the Aurora Replica to generate reports.
explaination_text: Offloading heavy read-only reporting queries to an Aurora Replica prevents performance impact on the primary writer instance used by the application.

question_text: 3-tier application NLB -> EC2 web -> EC2 app -> DB. Security of data in transit. What should a solutions architect do?
answer_text: Configure a TLS listener. Deploy the server certificate on the NLB.
explaination_text: Enabling a TLS listener on the Network Load Balancer ensures that traffic between the client and the entry point of the VPC is encrypted.

question_text: Migrate COTS on-prem app to AWS. Licensing based on sockets/cores with predictable requirements. Use existing licenses. MOST cost-effective EC2 option?
answer_text: Dedicated Reserved Hosts
explaination_text: Dedicated Hosts allow you to reuse existing per-socket/per-core licenses. The Reserved model provides the highest discount for predictable long-term usage.

question_text: Linux storage POSIX-compliant, HA, shared. 30 days frequent access then infrequent. Which solution is MOST cost-effective?
answer_text: Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard storage class. Create a lifecycle management policy to move to EFS Standard-IA.
explaination_text: EFS is POSIX-compliant and shared. Lifecycle management automatically moves data to the Infrequent Access (IA) tier to save costs after 30 days.

question_text: VPC design: LB (Public), Web (Private), MySQL (Private). Each resource least privilege required. Which configuration strategy?
answer_text: Security group for web allow port 443 from LB. Security group for MySQL allow port 3306 from web security group.
explaination_text: This follows security group chaining, ensuring that only the specific upstream tier can access the ports of the downstream tier.

question_text: Identical datasets frequently returned from RDS MySQL causing slowdown. Improve performance of backend. Which action?
answer_text: Implement Amazon ElastiCache to cache the large datasets.
explaination_text: Caching frequently requested database results in memory (ElastiCache) reduces the load on the database and drastically improves response times.

question_text: Deployment engineer using CloudFormation.Principle of least privilege. Which combination of actions? (Choose two.)
answer_text: D. Create IAM user in a group with CloudFormation-only permissions. E. Create IAM role for engineer to define permissions for the stack and launch stacks using that role.
explaination_text: Grouping users restricts their general access. Using a specific Service Role for CloudFormation execution ensures only the required permissions are used for resource creation.

question_text: Web Auto Scaling group (Public) cannot connect to RDS MySQL (Private). Fix? All default states.
answer_text: Add an inbound rule to the security group of the database tier’s RDS instance to allow traffic from the web tier's security group.
explaination_text: By default, security groups deny all inbound traffic. You must explicitly allow the web tier to connect to the database port (3306).

question_text: RDS MySQL Single-AZ. Run reporting queries without impacting production write operations. Which solution?
answer_text: Deploy RDS read replicas to process the business reporting queries.
explaination_text: Read replicas provide an asynchronous copy of the database specifically for read-heavy workloads like reporting.

question_text: Backup strategy stateless web/app EC2 in ASG and RDS PostgreSQL. No temporary local storage needed. RPO 2 hours. Strategy?
answer_text: Retain the latest Amazon Machine Images (AMIs). Enable automated backups in Amazon RDS and use point-in-time recovery.
explaination_text: Since the instances are stateless, an AMI is sufficient for the compute tier. RDS automated backups provide PITR to meet the 2-hour RPO.

question_text: New public web app EC2 web -> RDS MySQL. Secure/accessible for global dynamic IPs. Security groups? Which solution?
answer_text: Configure web SG to allow 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Configure DB SG to allow 3306 from web SG.
explaination_text: Web tier must be open to all IPs for a public app. Database tier is restricted to internal traffic from the web servers only.

question_text: Voice communication recordings S3. Capture text and remove PII. What should a solutions architect do?
answer_text: Configure an Amazon Transcribe transcription job with PII redaction. Invoke Lambda when file uploaded to start job. Store output in separate S3 bucket.
explaination_text: Amazon Transcribe can automatically identify and redact PII from audio transcriptions. Lambda automates the processing trigger.

question_text: RDS MySQL Multi-AZ gp3. Performance degrades when read/write IOPS > 20,000. Improve performance?
answer_text: Replace the volume with a Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volume.
explaination_text: Provisioned IOPS (io2) is designed for high-performance, I/O intensive databases that require more than the throughput and IOPS limits of gp3.

question_text: Which IAM user made configuration changes to AWS resources in production last week? Which service should be used?
answer_text: AWS CloudTrail
explaination_text: CloudTrail logs all API calls made in the account, providing a history of who performed what action and when.

question_text: Protect self-managed DNS solution (EC2 instances in different Regions + Global Accelerator) against DDoS attacks. What should be done?
answer_text: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Add the accelerator as a resource to protect.
explaination_text: Shield Advanced provides advanced protection for Global Accelerator, including L3/L4 protection and integration with the DDoS Response Team.

question_text: Scheduled daily agg/filter job 10 GB S3 records. Job takes up to hour. Constant CPU/Memory. Minimize operational effort. Which solution?
answer_text: Create an Amazon ECS cluster with AWS Fargate. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event to launch ECS task.
explaination_text: Fargate is a serverless container engine. Scheduling a task with EventBridge ensures the job runs once daily without managing a dedicated server.

question_text: Transfer 600 TB sensitive data to AWS within 2 weeks. 100 Mbps internet speed. MOST cost-effectively?
answer_text: Use the AWS Snow Family console to order several AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. Use devices to transfer data to S3.
explaination_text: 100 Mbps is too slow for 600 TB. Snowball Edge provides a high-speed physical alternative for moving large datasets to S3 within the required timeframe.

question_text: API Gateway Regional API. Security team concerned about HTTP flood attacks. LEAST operational overhead?
answer_text: Create a Regional AWS WAF web ACL with a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the API Gateway stage.
explaination_text: A WAF rate-based rule automatically blocks IP addresses that exceed a certain threshold of requests, protecting against floods with minimal management.

question_text: Meteorological app DynamoDB. Send alerts to managers of four internal teams every time new weather event recorded. LEAST operational overhead?
answer_text: Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams on the table. Use triggers to write to a single Amazon SNS topic to which the teams can subscribe.
explaination_text: DynamoDB Streams and SNS provide an automated, event-driven notification system that doesn't impact the performance of the core database.

question_text: A company wants to use the AWS Cloud to make an existing application highly available and resilient. The current version of the application resides in the company's data center. The application recently experienced data loss after a database server crashed because of an unexpected power outage. The company needs a solution that avoids any single points of failure. The solution must give the application the ability to scale to meet user demand. Which solution will meet these requirements?
answer_text: Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ configuration.
explaination_text: Using an Auto Scaling group (ASG) across multiple AZs ensures compute resiliency. RDS Multi-AZ provides a synchronous standby in a different AZ, which automatically fails over if the primary crashes, preventing the data loss experienced on-premises.

question_text: A company needs to handle large amounts of streaming data to an Amazon S3 bucket for BI processing. The company observes that Amazon S3 is not receiving all the data that the application sends to Kinesis Data Streams. What should a solutions architect do to resolve this issue?
answer_text: Check the Kinesis Data Streams shard limit and increase the number of shards if necessary. Monitor the ReadProvisionedThroughputExceeded and WriteProvisionedThroughputExceeded metrics.
explaination_text: Kinesis Data Streams is throttled at the shard level. If the incoming data rate exceeds the capacity of the provisioned shards, data will be lost or rejected. Increasing shards resolves throughput bottlenecks.

question_text: A developer has an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to upload files to Amazon S3 and needs the required permissions. The developer already has an IAM user with valid credentials. What should a solutions architect do to grant the permissions?
answer_text: Create an IAM execution role with the required permissions and attach the IAM role to the Lambda function.
explaination_text: Lambda functions use execution roles to obtain temporary security credentials. Attaching a role directly to the function is more secure and operationally efficient than passing IAM user credentials.

question_text: A company has a serverless application that invokes a Lambda function when new documents are uploaded to S3. After a marketing campaign, the company noticed that the application did not process many of the documents. What should a solutions architect do to improve the architecture?
answer_text: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Send the requests to the queue. Configure the queue as an event source for Lambda.
explaination_text: Spikes in S3 uploads can exceed Lambda's concurrency limits, causing throttled requests to be lost. SQS acts as a buffer, holding messages until Lambda has capacity to process them.

question_text: A software demonstration environment on EC2/ALB experiences significant traffic during working hours but is not required on weekends. Which combination of actions ensures the system can scale? (Choose two.)
answer_text: A. Use AWS Auto Scaling to adjust the ALB capacity based on request rate. E. Use scheduled scaling to change the Auto Scaling group minimum, maximum, and desired capacity to zero for weekends.
explaination_text: Scaling the ALB ensures it can handle request volume, while scheduled scaling for the ASG is the most cost-effective way to shut down environments during known idle periods like weekends.

question_text: Web servers in a public subnet must be open on port 443. An Amazon RDS for MySQL instance in a database subnet must be accessible only to the web servers on port 3306. Which combination of steps should be taken? (Choose two.)
answer_text: C. Create a security group for the web servers to allow traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. D. Create a security group for the DB instance to allow traffic from the web servers’ security group on port 3306.
explaination_text: Security group chaining (referencing the web SG in the DB SG rule) ensures that the database is only accessible from the authorized application tier, following the principle of least privilege.

question_text: A company is implementing a shared storage solution for a gaming application that needs Lustre clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed. Which solution meets these requirements?
answer_text: Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
explaination_text: FSx for Lustre is a fully managed, high-performance file system designed for sub-millisecond latencies and high throughput, making it ideal for gaming and HPC workloads.

question_text: A company receives data from dispersed remote devices via UDP. The solution must minimize latency and provide rapid failover to another AWS Region. Which solution will meet these requirements?
answer_text: Use AWS Global Accelerator. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each Region as an endpoint. Create an Amazon ECS cluster with the Fargate launch type.
explaination_text: Global Accelerator provides static Anycast IPs and routes UDP traffic over the AWS global network for low latency. NLBs handle high-throughput UDP, and ECS Fargate allows for serverless regional scaling.

question_text: Migrate a Windows IIS web app that relies on a file share from on-premises to AWS. Which replacement for the on-premises file share is MOST resilient and durable?
answer_text: Migrate the file share to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.
explaination_text: FSx for Windows is a managed service providing highly available, durable SMB file storage that integrates natively with Windows workloads and Active Directory.

question_text: An application writes data to EBS volumes. The company needs to ensure that all data written to the EBS volumes is encrypted at rest. Which solution will meet this requirement?
answer_text: Create the EBS volumes as encrypted volumes. Attach the EBS volumes to the EC2 instances.
explaination_text: EBS encryption at rest is handled transparently by AWS. Encrypting the volume at creation ensures all data and snapshots associated with that volume are protected.

question_text: A web application has sporadic usage patterns (heavy monthly, moderate weekly, unpredictable daily). Move the MySQL DB to a cost-effective platform without requiring database modifications. Which solution meets this?
answer_text: MySQL-compatible Amazon Aurora Serverless
explaination_text: Aurora Serverless scales capacity up and down automatically based on actual usage, which is perfect for sporadic workloads and requires no code changes for MySQL-compatible apps.

question_text: An image-hosting company wants to avoid accidental exposure of objects in S3 buckets to the public. All S3 objects in the account must remain private. Which solution meets these requirements?
answer_text: Use the S3 Block Public Access feature on the account level. Use AWS Organizations to create a service control policy (SCP) that prevents IAM users from changing the setting.
explaination_text: Account-level Block Public Access is a 'master switch' to prevent accidental exposure. An SCP ensures that even account administrators cannot disable this safeguard.

question_text: Increase in traffic causes delays in sending marketing and order confirmation emails. Reduce complexity and minimize operational overhead. What should a solutions architect do?
answer_text: Configure the web instance to send email through Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES).
explaination_text: Amazon SES is a managed email service that removes the burden of managing SMTP servers and reputation, providing high deliverability and scalability.

question_text: Store petabytes of data in S3 with varying and unknown access patterns. Optimize cost with MOST operational efficiency. Which solution?
answer_text: Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration with a rule to transition the objects in the S3 bucket to S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
explaination_text: Intelligent-Tiering automatically moves objects between tiers based on actual access patterns, providing the most cost-effective storage for large datasets where access frequency is unknown.

question_text: Ecommerce global company users experience slow page loads. Combination of actions? (Choose two.)
answer_text: B. Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution. D. Create a read replica for the RDS DB instance.
explaination_text: CloudFront caches static/dynamic content closer to users to reduce latency. Read replicas offload read traffic from the main database, improving overall response times.

question_text: Allow team members in a 'development' account to access S3 buckets in a 'production' account using an IAM role. Principle of least privilege. Which solution?
answer_text: Add the development account as a principal in the trust policy of the role in the production account.
explaination_text: Trusting the development account ID in the production role allows users in the dev account to perform an 'sts:AssumeRole' action to gain temporary production access.

question_text: Audit discovered employees created unencrypted EBS volumes. Ensure all new EBS volumes in ap-southeast-2 are encrypted. Minimal effect on employees. Combination of steps? (Choose two.)
answer_text: C. Create an SCP to deny ec2:CreateVolume when condition ec2:Encrypted is false. E. In the Organizations management account, specify the Default EBS volume encryption setting.
explaination_text: Setting 'Encryption by Default' for the region automatically encrypts all new volumes. The SCP acts as a guardrail to explicitly deny any attempts to bypass encryption.

question_text: Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster for production. Ensure HA and failover in < 40 seconds. Offload reads and keep costs low. Which solution?
answer_text: Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment. Point the read workload to the reader endpoint.
explaination_text: RDS Multi-AZ Clusters (with 1 writer and 2 readers) offer faster failover times (typically under 35 seconds) than standard Multi-AZ instances and allow using the standby nodes for read traffic.

question_text: Highly available SFTP service for trusted IPs. Serverless option with high IOPS and mantaining control over permissions. Which solution?
answer_text: Create an encrypted Amazon EFS volume. Create an AWS Transfer Family SFTP service with a VPC endpoint. Attach the EFS volume to the SFTP endpoint.
explaination_text: AWS Transfer Family is serverless. Using EFS as the backend provides scalable high IOPS storage. VPC endpoints with security groups restrict access to trusted source IPs.

question_text: Microservices fetch 1 GB model data from S3. Irregular usage patterns (idle for days or thousands of requests). Which design meets this?
answer_text: Direct requests into an SQS queue. Deploy models as Amazon ECS services that read from the queue. Enable Auto Scaling based on queue size.
explaination_text: Decoupling with SQS and scaling ECS based on backlog (queue size) handles the 'bursty' nature of the requests while allowing resources to scale down to near-zero when idle.

question_text: Custom app with frontend (24/7) and backend (short time/varying). MOST cost-effectively scale?
answer_text: Use Reserved Instances for the frontend nodes. Use Spot Instances for the backend nodes.
explaination_text: Reserved Instances provide deep discounts for 'always-on' frontends. Spot Instances are perfect for the variable, interruptible processing tasks of the backend.

question_text: Migrate workload to EC2. Transaction peak < 15,000 IOPS. Provision performance independent of storage capacity MOST cost-effectively.
answer_text: GP3 volume type
explaination_text: gp3 volumes allow users to provision IOPS and throughput independently of the volume size, making them cheaper than io1/io2 for workloads up to 16,000 IOPS.

question_text: Store healthcare data. New regulation requires audit access at all levels. Migrate from on-prem securely. Which solution?
answer_text: Use AWS Storage Gateway to move the existing data to Amazon S3. Use AWS CloudTrail to log management events.
explaination_text: Storage Gateway facilitates the migration to S3. CloudTrail provides the mandatory auditing of who accessed the data or changed the configuration.

question_text: Deploy high available Java app on Apache Tomcat. What should be done?
answer_text: Deploy the application by using AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Configure a load-balanced environment and a rolling deployment policy.
explaination_text: Elastic Beanstalk simplifies Java/Tomcat deployments by handling the underlying infrastructure, high availability, and deployment strategies automatically.

question_text: Lambda needs read/write to DynamoDB table. Which solution gives access MOST securely?
answer_text: Create an IAM role that includes Lambda as a trusted service. Attach a policy allowing access to the table. Update Lambda to use the role as execution role.
explaination_text: Lambda execution roles provide temporary credentials and are the standard secure method for granting AWS services access to each other.

question_text: CSV files from machine sensors in S3. Convert to images available ASAP. CSVs kept for ML twice a year. Audits planned in advance. MOST cost-effectively? (Choose two.)
answer_text: B. Use Lambda function to convert CSV into images. C. Create Lifecycle rules to transition CSV to S3 Glacier after 1 day and expire image files after 30 days.
explaination_text: Lambda processes images ASAP. Moving the large CSV files to Glacier after one day saves storage costs while still allowing for the biannual ML training.

question_text: Web game scoreboard (RDS MySQL) needs top-10 in near-real time and ability to stop/restore game while preserving scores. What should be done?
answer_text: Set up an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to compute and cache the scores for the web application to display.
explaination_text: Redis 'Sorted Sets' are a native feature specifically designed for building real-time scoreboards efficiently.

question_text: Ecommerce ML models: build/train/visualize complexities and trends. Analyze in BI dashboards with LEAST operational overhead. Which solution?
answer_text: Use Amazon SageMaker to build and train models. Use Amazon QuickSight to visualize the data.
explaination_text: SageMaker and QuickSight are both fully managed services that integrate natively, providing the most streamlined path from model to visualization.

question_text: Multi-account organization. Prevent modification of cost usage tags. Which solution meets this?
answer_text: Create a service control policy (SCP) to prevent tag modification except by authorized principals.
explaination_text: SCPs allow centralized restriction of IAM actions (like 'untag') across all accounts in an organization, ensuring cost integrity.

question_text: Migrate 20 TB MySQL to AWS within 2 weeks with minimal downtime. MOST cost-effectively?
answer_text: Order an AWS Snowball Edge device. Use AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) with SCT. Finish migration and continue replication.
explaination_text: Snowball handles the bulk data transfer (20 TB) within the timeframe. DMS replication then picks up only the changes made during the physical transfer for minimal downtime.

question_text: RDS PostgreSQL workload has increased. Accommodate larger workload without adding infrastructure MOST cost-effectively.
answer_text: Buy reserved DB instances for the total workload. Make the Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance larger.
explaination_text: Vertical scaling (making the instance larger) is more straightforward than re-architecting. Committing to Reserved Instances offsets the cost of the larger instance size.

question_text: Ecommerce ALB/ASG site performance issues from illegitimate requests with changing IPs. Minimal impact on legitimate users. Recommendation?
answer_text: Deploy AWS WAF, associate it with the ALB, and configure a rate-limiting rule.
explaination_text: AWS WAF rate-limiting automatically throttles IP addresses that make too many requests, protecting the origin while allowing legitimate users to pass.

question_text: Share private RDS database with external auditor who needs their own copy. MOST secure way?
answer_text: Create an encrypted snapshot. Share the snapshot. Allow access to the AWS KMS encryption key.
explaination_text: Sharing a snapshot allows the auditor to restore their own instance. For encrypted data, the target account must also be granted access to the specific KMS key.

question_text: VPC CIDR too small for growing EC2 instances. Resolve with LEAST operational overhead.
answer_text: Add an additional IPv4 CIDR block to increase the number of IP addresses and create additional subnets in the VPC.
explaination_text: VPCs allow adding additional secondary CIDR blocks to an existing VPC, which is easier than migrating resources to a brand new VPC.

question_text: Backups created: database dump and RDS final snapshot. Create new Aurora MySQL DB from most recent backup. Which solutions? (Choose two.)
answer_text: A. Import the RDS snapshot directly into Aurora. C. Upload the database dump to Amazon S3. Then import the database dump into Aurora.
explaination_text: Aurora supports both direct RDS snapshot imports and importing SQL dumps stored in S3, providing multiple migration paths.

question_text: ASG launches more On-Demand instances when users access high volumes of static web content. Redesign MOST cost-effectively.
answer_text: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution to host the static web contents from an Amazon S3 bucket.
explaination_text: Offloading static content to S3 and CloudFront prevents the EC2 fleet from scaling up unnecessarily, significantly reducing compute costs.

question_text: Share selective data lake (Lake Formation) with engineering team for analysis. LEAST operational overhead?
answer_text: Use Lake Formation tag-based access control to authorize and grant cross-account permissions.
explaination_text: Tag-based access control allows for high granularity (column/row-level) and scales across many accounts without complex IAM policy management.

question_text: Scalable web app. Users download/upload GB unique data. Minimize latency and maximize performance cost-effectively.
answer_text: Use Amazon S3 with Transfer Acceleration to host the application.
explaination_text: Transfer Acceleration uses the CloudFront edge network to speed up long-distance uploads and downloads to S3.

question_text: One RDS instance + two EC2 servers in single AZ. Employee accidentally deleted RDS. Maximize reliability of application infrastructure?
answer_text: Update DB to Multi-AZ and enable deletion protection. Place EC2 in ASG across multiple AZs behind an ALB.
explaination_text: Multi-AZ and ASG provide high availability. Deletion protection prevents the specific 'accidental deletion' risk that caused the original downtime.

question_text: Move 700 TB NAS to cloud within 90 days. Efficient and without disruption. Still need to access/update data during transfer. Which solution?
answer_text: Create an AWS DataSync agent in the corporate data center. Start the transfer to an Amazon S3 bucket.
explaination_text: DataSync can handle background transfers while applications are still using the source storage, making it ideal for non-disruptive migrations.

question_text: Retain all new and existing S3 PDF data for 7 years. LEAST operational overhead?
answer_text: Turn on S3 Object Lock with compliance retention mode. Use S3 Batch Operations to bring existing data into compliance.
explaination_text: Object Lock compliance mode is the most robust retention tool. Batch Operations is the most efficient way to apply that lock to existing historical data.

question_text: Stateless web app (API Gateway + Lambda). Deploy across multiple Regions to provide Regional failover. What should be done?
answer_text: Create Amazon Route 53 health checks for each Region. Use an active-active failover configuration.
explaination_text: Route 53 active-active configuration with health checks ensures that traffic is automatically shifted to a healthy region if one fails.

question_text: VPC Management uses VPN. VPC Production uses Direct Connect. Shared VPC Peering. Mitigate single point of failure in architecture?
answer_text: Add a second set of VPNs to the Management VPC from a second customer gateway device.
explaination_text: Adding a second VPN path from a different physical on-premises device eliminates the single point of failure for the Management network.

question_text: Migrate Oracle DB quickly. Use third-party features that require privileged access. MOST cost-effectively?
answer_text: Migrate the database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Customize settings to support third-party features.
explaination_text: RDS Custom provides the benefits of a managed service while allowing the specialized operating system and database configuration required for some enterprise features.

question_text: Migrate single-server three-tier app to AWS aligned with Well-Architected Framework (security, scalability, resiliency). Which combination? (Choose three.)
answer_text: C. VPC across two AZs with Auto Scaling tiers. E. ELB in front of web tier. F. Multi-AZ RDS Cluster in private subnets.
explaination_text: This setup implements high availability (Multi-AZ), scalability (Auto Scaling), and security (Private subnets and ELBs).

question_text: Migrating to ECS, Direct Connect, and RDS. Which activities will be managed by the company's operational team? (Choose three.)
answer_text: B. Creation of RDS DB instance and maintenance window. C. Configuration of ECS software for monitoring/patching. F. Encryption of data in transit through Direct Connect.
explaination_text: Under the Shared Responsibility Model, the customer manages resource provisioning (RDS setup), application-level software (monitoring agents), and data protection (Direct Connect encryption).

question_text: Java job runs every hour for 10 seconds. Consumes 1 GB memory. CPU surges during execution. Optimize costs.
answer_text: Copy code into an AWS Lambda function with 1 GB memory. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule.
explaination_text: Lambda is billed by the millisecond. For a 10-second job once an hour, Lambda is orders of magnitude cheaper than keeping an EC2 instance running.

question_text: Backup strategy for EC2 and S3. Regulatory requirement: retain files for time period and do not alter them. Which solution?
answer_text: Use AWS Backup to create a backup vault that has a vault lock in compliance mode.
explaination_text: AWS Backup Vault Lock in 'Compliance Mode' ensures that backups are immutable and cannot be deleted or altered, even by the root user.

question_text: Resources across multiple Regions and accounts. No details on inventory. Build map and relationship details MOST operationally efficient way.
answer_text: Use Workload Discovery on AWS to generate architecture diagrams of the workloads.
explaination_text: Workload Discovery (part of the AWS Perspective framework) is an automated tool that visualizes AWS resource relationships across accounts and regions.

question_text: AWS Organizations. Accounts with different budgets. Receive alerts and automatically prevent provisioning when budget threshold met. Which combination? (Choose three.)
answer_text: B. Create AWS Budgets. D. Create IAM role for budget actions. F. Add alert and budget action with SCP.
explaination_text: AWS Budgets can trigger automated actions, like applying an SCP, to stop further costs once a threshold is reached.

question_text: Back up EC2 instances in one Region to a second Region. provision resources and manage centrally from one account MOST cost-effectively.
answer_text: Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup. Configure cross-Region backup to the second Region for the EC2 instances.
explaination_text: AWS Backup is a centralized service that natively supports cross-region backup copies for multiple services with a simple policy.

question_text: Transfer data to a product manufacturer. Use company IdP for authentication and AS2 protocol. Which solution?
answer_text: Use AWS Transfer Family to transfer the data. Create an AWS Lambda function for IdP authentication.
explaination_text: AWS Transfer Family is the managed service for AS2 transfers. Custom Lambda authorizers allow it to integrate with any existing identity provider.

question_text: REST API (API Gateway) requires 1 GB memory, 2 GB storage, and relational format data. LEAST administrative effort? (Choose two.)
answer_text: B. AWS Lambda. C. Amazon RDS.
explaination_text: Lambda (compute) and RDS (storage) are both managed services that significantly reduce administrative burden compared to EC2 and self-managed databases.

question_text: Accounting team needs to determine EC2 consumption by department tags regardless of account. MOST operationally efficient way?
answer_text: From management account activate user-defined cost allocation tag 'department'. Create report in Cost Explorer grouping by tag.
explaination_text: Cost Allocation Tags are required to track specific metadata in billing. Activating them in the management account enables organization-wide reporting.

question_text: Securely exchange data between Salesforce and S3. Encrypt at rest (KMS) and transit. Which solution?
answer_text: Create Amazon AppFlow flows to transfer the data securely from Salesforce to Amazon S3.
explaination_text: Amazon AppFlow is a managed integration service that handles the secure, encrypted connection between SaaS applications and S3.

question_text: Mobile game (EC2 ASG + DynamoDB). Uses TCP/UDP. Used globally. lowest possible latency. Which solution?
answer_text: Use AWS Global Accelerator. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) behind an accelerator endpoint. update ASG.
explaination_text: Global Accelerator provides the lowest latency entry point for both TCP and UDP traffic globally. NLB provides high-performance routing to the servers.

question_text: Customer order workload (EC2 + Aurora) doesn't process fast enough when traffic high. Write orders reliably as quickly as possible.
answer_text: Write orders to an Amazon SQS queue. Use EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to read from the queue.
explaination_text: SQS decouples the order ingestion from the processing. This allows the system to scale the compute tier based on the queue size without dropping orders.

question_text: Sleep sensor data (2 MB/night/mattress). process/summarize ASAP. 1 GB memory, 30 sec execution. MOST cost-effectively?
answer_text: Use AWS Lambda with a Python script.
explaination_text: Lambda's pay-per-execution model is perfect for millions of small, short-lived tasks (30 seconds), making it more cost-effective than running idle servers.

question_text: RDS PostgreSQL Single-AZ. eliminate single points of failure and minimize downtime without code changes. Which solution?
answer_text: Convert existing database instance to a Multi-AZ deployment by modifying the instance.
explaination_text: A Multi-AZ modification is a simple console/CLI action that sets up synchronous replication to another AZ, providing failover without changing the connection endpoint.

question_text: EC2 Nitro instances within same AZ. Give application ability to write to multiple block storage volumes simultaneously. Which solution?
answer_text: Use Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS volumes with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach.
explaination_text: EBS Multi-Attach allows multiple Nitro-based EC2 instances in the same AZ to concurrently mount a single Provisioned IOPS volume.

question_text: Stateless app (EC2 single AZ + RDS Multi-AZ). Ensure app highly available. What should be done?
answer_text: Configure the application to use Multi-AZ EC2 Auto Scaling and create an Application Load Balancer.
explaination_text: Moving the stateless compute tier into a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group behind an ALB provides redundancy and automatic failure recovery.

question_text: Compute Savings Plan in member account not fully used (< 50%). How to ensure full benefit?
answer_text: Turn on discount sharing from the Billing Preferences section in the management account.
explaination_text: Enabling discount sharing allows unused Savings Plans benefits from one account to be applied to eligible spend in other accounts in the organization.

question_text: Microservices app search catalog. REST APIs must access backend services in containers in private VPC subnets. Which solution?
answer_text: Design REST API via API Gateway. Host in Amazon ECS in private subnet. Create private VPC link for API Gateway access.
explaination_text: A VPC Link allows API Gateway to route traffic directly to internal load balancers or services in private subnets without traversing the public internet.

question_text: Raw data in S3. Unpredictable/uncontrollable access pattern. Reduce S3 costs. Which solution meets this?
answer_text: Use S3 Lifecycle rules to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
explaination_text: S3 Intelligent-Tiering is designed specifically for workloads where access patterns are unknown or unpredictable, automating cost savings.

question_text: EC2 IPv6 addresses must initiate communications with external apps, but external apps cannot initiate connections to them. Resolve this?
answer_text: Create an egress-only internet gateway and make it the destination of the subnet's route table.
explaination_text: An Egress-Only Internet Gateway is an IPv6-specific resource that allows instances to connect to the internet while blocking all inbound connection attempts.

question_text: Container app stores/accesses 1 TB S3 daily. Minimize costs and prevent traffic from traversing internet. Which solution?
answer_text: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Associate this endpoint with all route tables in the VPC.
explaination_text: S3 Gateway Endpoints keep all traffic on the private AWS network at no extra cost, avoiding data processing fees from NAT Gateways.

question_text: Mobile chat DynamoDB. Users want messages read with as little latency as possible. Minimal changes to app. Which method?
answer_text: Configure Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) for the table. Update code to use DAX endpoint.
explaination_text: DAX provides in-memory caching for DynamoDB, reducing read latency from milliseconds to microseconds with almost zero re-coding.

question_text: Static website (EC2/ALB). traffic increasing, concerned about increase in cost. Which solution?
answer_text: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution to cache files at edge locations.
explaination_text: CloudFront caches content globally, reducing the amount of data served directly from EC2 and reducing the cost of data transfer out.

question_text: VPCs across Regions must communicate with all other VPCs across all Regions. LEAST amount of administrative effort?
answer_text: Use AWS Transit Gateway to manage VPC communication in a Region and Transit Gateway peering across Regions.
explaination_text: Transit Gateway simplifies networking by replacing multiple VPC peering connections with a central hub that can also peer with hubs in other regions.

question_text: ECS app needs shared file system highly durable, recover data to another Region (RPO 8 hours). mount target in each AZ. Which solution?
answer_text: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with the Standard storage class.
explaination_text: EFS Standard is designed for Multi-AZ durability and performance, and integrates with AWS Backup for cross-region replication.

question_text: Rapid growth. configuring users and granting permissions. IAM groups based on department. MOST secure way to grant permissions to new users?
answer_text: Create an IAM policy that grants least privilege permission. Attach the policy to the IAM groups.
explaination_text: Managing permissions at the group level ensures consistent application of the principle of least privilege as new employees are hired.

question_text: Public files readable but no modifications/deletions before designated future date. MOST secure way?
answer_text: Create new S3 bucket with versioning. Use S3 Object Lock with retention period. Configure for static hosting and read-only access.
explaination_text: Object Lock provides the mandatory WORM (Write Once Read Many) protection required for legal or firm compliance.

question_text: Prototype (ASG, ALB, RDS) needs immediate automated deployment in two AZs. Recommendation?
answer_text: Define the infrastructure as a template by using the prototype as a guide. Deploy with AWS CloudFormation.
explaination_text: CloudFormation is the native 'Infrastructure as Code' service for AWS, allowing for fast, repeatable, and automated deployments.

question_text: EC2 uses S3 for encrypted object storage. traffic must not traverse public internet. Which capability?
answer_text: VPC endpoint
explaination_text: Gateway VPC endpoints provide direct, private routing to S3, bypassing the public internet entirely.

question_text: Web app (RDS MySQL + ElastiCache). Update cache when customer adds item to database. Always match. Which solution?
answer_text: Implement the write-through caching strategy.
explaination_text: Write-through caching ensures that data is written to both the database and the cache simultaneously, maintaining strict data consistency.

question_text: Migrate 100 GB from on-prem to S3. 100 Mbps connection. Encrypt in transit. LEAST operational overhead?
answer_text: Use AWS DataSync to migrate the data from the on-premises location to an S3 bucket.
explaination_text: AWS DataSync is a specialized, managed service for fast and secure data transfers, providing higher performance than standard CLI copies.

question_text: Windows job runs every 10 mins (runtime 1-3 mins). MOST cost-effectively?
answer_text: Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate. Create a scheduled task to run every 10 minutes.
explaination_text: Fargate is serverless, meaning you only pay for the exact duration (1-3 minutes) the job is running, rather than keeping an EC2 instance on 24/7.

question_text: Consolidated, multi-account architecture. Authenticate access via centralized corporate directory. Combination of actions? (Choose two.)
answer_text: A. Create organization in Organizations. E. Set up AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS SSO) and integrate with corporate directory.
explaination_text: AWS Organizations manages the account structure, while IAM Identity Center (formerly SSO) provides the central authentication link to external directories like AD.

question_text: Store news archives rarely restored. Minimize costs. restored in max 5 mins. MOST cost-effective solution?
answer_text: Store the video archives in Amazon S3 Glacier and use Expedited retrievals.
explaination_text: S3 Glacier offers very low storage costs. Expedited retrievals fulfill the 5-minute restoration requirement (vs. hours for standard or days for deep archive).

question_text: Three-tier app (Static site, Container logic tier, Relational DB). Simplify deployment and reduce operational costs. Which solution?
answer_text: Use Amazon S3 to host static content. Use Amazon ECS with Fargate for compute. Use a managed Amazon RDS cluster for DB.
explaination_text: This setup maximizes the use of managed and serverless services, offloading most operational tasks like server patching and maintenance to AWS.

question_text: Highly available and scalable storage solution for Linux instances (AWS and on-prem). no minimum size. Which solution?
answer_text: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with multiple mount targets.
explaination_text: EFS provides a scalable, POSIX-compliant file system that can be accessed from multiple VPC subnets and on-premises via VPN/Direct Connect.

question_text: Billing information on member accounts must not be accessible to anyone including root. Which solution?
answer_text: Create a service control policy (SCP) to deny access to the billing information. Attach the SCP to the root organizational unit (OU).
explaination_text: An SCP is the only mechanism that can restrict actions for the root user of a member account.

question_text: SNS order messages not received by on-prem endpoint. Retain and analyze failed messages for 14 days with LEAST effort.
answer_text: Configure an Amazon SNS dead letter queue that has an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) target with 14-day retention.
explaination_text: DLQs catch failed messages. SQS natively supports a 14-day retention period, allowing ample time for analysis.

question_text: Configure continuous backups to S3 with minimal coding. Backups must not affect DynamoDB availability or RCUs.
answer_text: Export the data directly from DynamoDB to Amazon S3. Turn on point-in-time recovery for the table.
explaination_text: DynamoDB native export to S3 uses Kinesis/serverless capacity and does not consume the table's provisioned RCUs, preventing performance impact.

question_text: Centrally restrict creation of oversized EC2 instances in development accounts. LEAST development effort?
answer_text: Use AWS Organizations to organize accounts into OUs. Define and attach an SCP to control the usage of EC2 instance types.
explaination_text: SCPs provide a centralized, policy-driven way to restrict specific API parameters (like instance type) across multiple accounts without manual configuration.

question_text: Written sentiment reports from call recordings in 4 languages translated to English. Combination of steps? (Choose three.)
answer_text: D. Amazon Transcribe (Speech-to-Text). E. Amazon Translate (Translate to English). F. Amazon Comprehend (Sentiment analysis).
explaination_text: This is the standard 'AI pipeline' in AWS: convert speech to text, translate to a common language, and analyze sentiment on the resulting text.

question_text: IAM condition question regarding CIDR blocks.
answer_text: The request to terminate the EC2 instance does not originate from the CIDR blocks 192.0.2.0/24 or 203.0.113.0/24.

question_text: Ensure data in S3 doesn't contain sensitive customer data (PII). Discover passport and credit card numbers. Which solution?
answer_text: Configure Amazon Macie to run a data discovery job that uses managed identifiers for the required data types.
explaination_text: Amazon Macie is the native AWS service designed for automated sensitive data discovery and classification in S3.

question_text: Applications use both block storage and NFS storage. Need high-performing solution that supports local caching without re-architecting. Combination of actions? (Choose two.)
answer_text: B. Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway to replace NFS. D. Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway to replace block.
explaination_text: AWS Storage Gateway modes mimic common storage protocols (NFS for file, iSCSI for block) while providing local caching and S3 persistence.

question_text: Service reads/writes large amounts from S3 in same Region. EC2 in private subnet via NAT gateway. Reduce data output costs MOST cost-effectively.
answer_text: Provision a VPC gateway endpoint. Configure the route table for the private subnet to use the gateway endpoint.
explaination_text: NAT Gateways charge data processing fees per GB. S3 Gateway Endpoints are free and route traffic over the private AWS backbone.

question_text: High-resolution pictures in S3 as latest version. Retain only two most recent versions. Reduce S3 costs with LEAST overhead.
answer_text: Use S3 Lifecycle to delete expired object versions and retain the two most recent versions.
explaination_text: S3 Lifecycle policies can be configured to specifically target non-current versions, keeping only the N most recent ones automatically.

question_text: Minimize cost of 1 Gbps Direct Connect. utilization < 10%. Reduce cost without compromising security.
answer_text: Contact an AWS Direct Connect Partner to order a 200 Mbps hosted connection.
explaination_text: Hosted connections allow for smaller bandwidth increments (like 200 Mbps) which are significantly cheaper than a dedicated 1 Gbps line when not needed.

question_text: Migrate multiple Windows servers on-prem to FSx for Windows. Preserve file permissions. Which solutions? (Choose two.)
answer_text: A. Deploy AWS DataSync agents on premises. D. Order an AWS Snowcone device.
explaination_text: DataSync is the primary tool for migrating files to FSx while preserving ACLs/permissions. Snowcone is a portable data transfer device that can run DataSync agents in remote locations.

question_text: A company wants to ingest customer payment data into the company's data lake in Amazon S3. The company receives payment data every minute on average. The company wants to analyze the payment data in real time. Then the company wants to ingest the data into the data lake. Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?
answer_text: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to ingest data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to analyze the data in real time.
explaination_text: Kinesis Data Firehose is a fully managed service that loads streaming data into S3. Integrating it with Kinesis Data Analytics allows for real-time SQL-based analysis of the data before it is persisted in the S3 data lake.

question_text: A company runs a website that uses a content management system (CMS) on EC2 with an Aurora MySQL Multi-AZ DB. Website images are on an EBS volume. Which combination of actions improves performance and resilience? (Choose two.)
answer_text: C. Move website images onto an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. E. Create an AMI from the existing instance and use an Auto Scaling group with an ALB and CloudFront.
explaination_text: EFS provides shared, durable storage accessible by multiple EC2 instances. Moving to an ASG with an ALB ensures high availability, while CloudFront improves global performance through edge caching.

question_text: A company is building a feature to monitor data in customer AWS accounts. The feature will call APIs to describe EC2 instances and read CloudWatch metrics. What is the MOST secure way to obtain access?
answer_text: Ensure that the customers create an IAM role in their account with read-only EC2 and CloudWatch permissions and a trust policy to the company’s account.
explaination_text: Cross-account IAM roles with a trust relationship are the secure standard for third-party access, as they provide temporary credentials and follow the principle of least privilege.

question_text: A company needs to connect several VPCs in us-east-1 that span hundreds of AWS accounts managed by a networking team. What is the MOST operationally efficient solution?
answer_text: Create an AWS Transit Gateway in the networking team’s AWS account. Configure static routes from each VPC.
explaination_text: AWS Transit Gateway acts as a central hub for connecting multiple VPCs and accounts, greatly simplifying the management of complex network architectures compared to VPC peering.

question_text: A company has EC2 instances that run nightly batch jobs between 12:00 AM and 06:00 AM. If a job fails, another instance reprocesses it. Which solution is MOST cost-effective?
answer_text: Create a new launch template for the Auto Scaling group. Set the instances to Spot Instances. Set a policy to scale out based on CPU usage.
explaination_text: Spot Instances provide significant cost savings for fault-tolerant, interruptible workloads like batch processing. Scaling based on CPU ensures resources are only active when work is being done.

question_text: A social media company expects significant increases in demand for photo uploads. Which solution meets these requirements with the MOST scalability?
answer_text: Generate Amazon S3 presigned URLs in the application. Upload files directly from the user's browser into an S3 bucket.
explaination_text: Presigned URLs allow users to upload directly to S3, bypassing application servers. This offloads the high-bandwidth task of data transfer from compute instances to S3’s native scalable infrastructure.

question_text: A ticketing application requires sub-1-second latency on updates to a reservation database that must be globally consistent across multiple AWS Regions. Which solution meets these requirements?
answer_text: Convert the application to use Amazon DynamoDB. Use a global table for the center reservation table. Use the correct Regional endpoint in each Regional deployment.
explaination_text: DynamoDB Global Tables provide a multi-region, multi-active database that automatically replicates data across regions with sub-second latency, providing global consistency and performance.

question_text: Back up EC2 workloads in us-west-1 and recover quickly in us-west-2 with < 24 hours data loss and LEAST administrative effort. Which solutions? (Choose two.)
answer_text: B. Create an EC2-backed AMI lifecycle policy with cross-region copy. D. Use AWS Backup to create a backup plan with cross-region copy to us-west-2.
explaination_text: Both Data Lifecycle Manager (for AMIs) and AWS Backup provide native, automated policy-based tools to handle snapshots and cross-region replication with minimal effort.

question_text: An application is receiving millions of illegitimate requests from a small number of IP addresses causing slow performance. Resolve the immediate problem quickly. Recommendation?
answer_text: Modify the network ACL for the web tier subnets. Add an inbound deny rule for the IP addresses that are consuming resources.
explaination_text: Network ACLs (NACLs) can block specific IP addresses at the subnet level. This is the fastest, lowest-level way to stop malicious traffic from reaching instances before more sophisticated rules (like WAF) are implemented.

question_text: Applications in eu-west-1 need to communicate securely with databases in ap-southeast-2. Which network design will meet these requirements?
answer_text: Configure a VPC peering connection between the ap-southeast-2 VPC and the eu-west-1 VPC. Update subnet route tables and security groups.
explaination_text: Inter-Region VPC Peering establishes a private network path over the AWS backbone between different regions, ensuring secure and private communication.

question_text: Multiple development environments and databases used 4 hours per day. Which solution is MOST cost-effective?
answer_text: Configure each development environment with its own Amazon Aurora On-Demand PostgreSQL-Compatible database.
explaination_text: Aurora Serverless (v1/v2) is cost-effective for development as it can pause during periods of inactivity (v1) or scale to minimum capacity (v2), saving on compute costs when not in use.

question_text: A company uses AWS Organizations and needs to back up all resources, including untagged ones, with LEAST operational overhead. Which solution?
answer_text: Use AWS Config to identify all untagged resources. Tag the identified resources programmatically. Use tags in the backup plan.
explaination_text: AWS Backup relies on tags for automated resource selection. Using AWS Config to enforce tagging ensures that every resource is captured by the backup policy.

question_text: Automatically resize images for multiple devices in a highly available, scalable solution with unpredictable traffic. Which solution?
answer_text: Create a static website hosted in Amazon S3 that invokes AWS Lambda functions to resize the images and store the images in an Amazon S3 bucket.
explaination_text: This serverless approach uses S3 for storage and Lambda for event-driven compute. It scales instantly to handle unpredictable traffic with no server management.

question_text: EKS cluster control plane private access set to true and public access set to false. Nodes in private subnets cannot join. Which solution?
answer_text: Create interface VPC endpoints to allow nodes to access the control plane.
explaination_text: In a private EKS cluster, nodes communicate with the API server over PrivateLink. Interface endpoints are required for nodes to securely reach the control plane without public internet access.

question_text: Which use cases are suitable for Amazon Redshift? (Choose three.)
answer_text: B. Client/server-side encryption. C. Analytics workloads during specified hours. E. Scaling to petabytes and millions of requests.
explaination_text: Redshift is a petabyte-scale data warehouse designed for high-performance complex SQL analytics and supports extensive encryption options for data security.

question_text: API must respond consistently with low latency during peak usage with LEAST operational overhead. Which solution?
answer_text: Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions with provisioned concurrency.
explaination_text: Provisioned Concurrency keeps Lambda functions 'warm' and ready to respond instantly, eliminating cold start delays and ensuring consistent low latency during traffic spikes.

question_text: Send all Systems Manager Session Manager logs to an Amazon S3 bucket for archival with MOST operational efficiency. Which solution?
answer_text: Enable S3 logging in the Systems Manager console. Choose an S3 bucket to send the session data to.
explaination_text: Systems Manager has a native integration that automatically streams Session Manager logs to a designated S3 bucket, requiring no custom scripts or additional services.

question_text: RDS MySQL instance is low on disk space. Increase space without downtime with LEAST effort. Which solution?
answer_text: Enable storage autoscaling in RDS.
explaination_text: RDS Storage Autoscaling automatically increases the volume size when it nears capacity, preventing 'out of space' errors without requiring manual intervention or downtime.

question_text: Centrally manage and deploy a common set of solutions and tools for customers for self-service purposes. Which solution?
answer_text: Create AWS Service Catalog products for the customers.
explaination_text: AWS Service Catalog allows organizations to create, govern, and manage a portfolio of approved IT services that users can self-provision following corporate standards.

question_text: Web app with unpredictable traffic using DynamoDB. Read/write throughput is moderate to high. MOST cost-effective configuration?
answer_text: Configure DynamoDB in on-demand mode by using the DynamoDB Standard table class.
explaination_text: On-demand mode is ideal for unpredictable traffic as it charges per request. For high-throughput scenarios without long-term cold data, the Standard table class is the most efficient choice.

question_text: Central reporting app must read items from multiple DynamoDB tables across team accounts in Organizations MOST securely. Which option?
answer_text: Create an IAM role (BU_ROLE) in every business account. In the inventory account, create a role (APP_ROLE) that assumes the BU_ROLE to read the tables.
explaination_text: Cross-account IAM roles are the secure method for accessing resources in different accounts. The application assumes a central role, which in turn assumes regional roles to perform reads.

question_text: EKS cluster workload inconsistent. Scale in and out with LEAST operational overhead. Which steps? (Choose two.)
answer_text: B. Use Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA). C. Use the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler.
explaination_text: HPA scales the number of pods based on metrics like CPU, while the Cluster Autoscaler adds or removes EC2 nodes when pods cannot be scheduled, ensuring both compute tiers scale dynamically.

question_text: Serverless web app must retrieve data from multiple DynamoDB tables with no impact on performance and MOST operationally efficient way. Which solution?
answer_text: Amazon CloudFront with Lambda@Edge functions.
explaination_text: Lambda@Edge allows you to fetch data and build dynamic responses at the edge locations closer to the user, improving performance while remaining fully serverless.

question_text: Analyze Access Denied/Unauthorized errors in CloudTrail with LEAST effort. Which solution?
answer_text: Search CloudTrail logs with Amazon Athena queries to identify the errors.
explaination_text: Athena provides a serverless SQL interface to analyze CloudTrail logs stored in S3, allowing for complex searches and rapid troubleshooting without setting up a database server.

question_text: Access usage cost data programmatically for current year and forecast 12 months with LEAST operational overhead. Which solution?
answer_text: Access usage cost-related data by using the AWS Cost Explorer API with pagination.
explaination_text: The Cost Explorer API is the native programmatic interface for accessing cost data, historical usage, and future forecasts directly from AWS billing.

question_text: Reduce downtime for scaling exercises and database failovers for Aurora PostgreSQL with LEAST operational overhead. Which solution?
answer_text: Set up an Amazon RDS proxy for the database. Update the application to use the proxy endpoint.
explaination_text: RDS Proxy maintains application connections during a database failover, reducing the downtime from minutes to seconds by transparently routing traffic to the new primary instance.

question_text: Subscription streaming service in single Region. Expand globally and ensure minimal downtime. MOST fault-tolerant solution?
answer_text: Deploy web/app tier to a second Region. Use Aurora Global Database. Use Route 53 health checks with failover routing.
explaination_text: This full multi-region architecture ensures that if one region fails, Route 53 shifts traffic to the second region, which already has a synchronized copy of the database.

question_text: MigrateTransactional and sensitive data to AWS. Increase security and reduce operational overhead for databases. Which solution?
answer_text: Migrate the databases to Amazon RDS. Configure encryption at rest.
explaination_text: RDS is a managed service that offloads administrative tasks and supports one-click encryption at rest, providing high security with low overhead.

question_text: Online game uses UDP. pointing traffic to NLBs in different Regions via Route 53. Improve performance and decrease latency. Which solution?
answer_text: Add AWS Global Accelerator in front of the NLBs. Configure a Global Accelerator endpoint.
explaination_text: Global Accelerator uses Anycast to route traffic over the private AWS backbone rather than the public internet, which is more reliable and faster for UDP traffic.

question_text: Integrate with third-party data feed using webhooks. Retrieve data via Lambda function. MOST operational efficiency?
answer_text: Create a function URL for the Lambda function. Provide the Lambda function URL to the third party.
explaination_text: Lambda Function URLs provide a built-in HTTPS endpoint for a single Lambda function, removing the cost and complexity of setting up an API Gateway for a simple webhook.

question_text: Provide individual and secure URLs for all customers via API Gateway REST API. Route 53 as DNS. MOST operational efficiency? (Choose three.)
answer_text: A. Wildcard record in Route 53. D. Wildcard certificate in ACM. F. Custom domain name in API Gateway with imported certificate.
explaination_text: Using wildcard domains and certificates allows the company to handle any number of customer subdomains (e.g., cust1.example.com) with a single certificate and configuration.

question_text: Automatically detect PII in S3 and notify the security team. Which solution will meet these requirements?
